name: wowstudio/wowstudio-accessibility-kit
description: Helps you find, fix, document, and monitor WCAG accessibility issues in WordPress at the code level.

scripts-descriptions.phpcs: Check the codebase against the WordPress Coding Standards.
scripts-descriptions.phpcbf: Auto-fix what the WordPress Coding Standards can fix.
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the PHPUnit suite. Requires PHP 8.1-8.4; Brain Monkey does not run on PHP 8.5.
scripts-descriptions.check-free-build: Assert no premium-only code or Freemius secret would ship in the free build.
scripts-descriptions.check-claims: Assert nothing shipped claims the user's site is compliant or certified.
scripts-descriptions.check-disclosures: Assert every conformance surface still carries its honesty disclosure.
